scope: Part 15C macro expansion into existing API v10 schemas and manual slash contributions; Swift 6.4 and SwiftSyntax compatibility.
reviewedContracts: API v10 option metadata retain existing validation, ordering and 25-option limit.
Generated code calls ArgumentOption and CommandArgumentSchema without a parallel wire decoder or reflection.
Manual execute methods retain the unique interaction responder and explicit acknowledgement ownership.
SwiftSyntax 604.0.0 is the current stable release verified for the Swift 6.4 host; only the separate macro package selects it.
Attached macros inspect their own declarations; external ArgumentValue implementations are checked through the existing Swift protocol.
qualification: Official source review and local compile/execution checks do not establish live Discord, other platforms/toolchains, capacity or complete Phase 15 qualification.
